download_bb2_model: download the bb2_module_supervision dialogue summarization model to the specified datapath directory
check_model_built: check if the bb2_module_supervision model v0.1 is already built before downloading
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the fits bb2_module_supervision model using get_model_dir
download_models_with_options: download model tar.gz files using download_models with datapath and model_type options
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how bb2_module_supervision model files are fetched
